description: This file defines a minimal API client for authentication-related endpoints, interacting with a backend server (presumably FastAPI) via HTTP. It includes methods for requesting OTP, verifying OTP, login, and signup, with fallback behavior for network issues.

classes.name: AuthApi
classes.description: A class providing methods to interact with authentication API endpoints, including OTP request/verification, login, and signup.

classes.name: _ApiResult
classes.description: A helper class encapsulating the result of API calls, indicating success/failure and holding response data or error message.

methods.name: AuthApi._postJson
methods.description: Internal method to send a POST request with JSON body and handle response status and decoding.

methods.name: AuthApi.requestOtp
methods.description: Requests an OTP for a given phone number.

methods.name: AuthApi.verifyOtp
methods.description: Verifies OTP for a phone number and returns an access token on success.

methods.name: AuthApi.login
methods.description: Performs login with phone or email and password, returning an access token.

methods.name: AuthApi.signupPassword
methods.description: Creates a new user account with password and related info, returning an access token.

methods.name: _ApiResult.ok
methods.description: Factory method to create a successful result.

methods.name: _ApiResult.err
methods.description: Factory method to create an error result.
